# Quick Start

The employee mesh is a working ReAct agent: a natural language question arrives, the agent generates SQL, the SQL tool executes it against SQLite, the result comes back, the agent answers. Two actors. One bus. No framework.

## Prerequisites

```sh
# system deps (Debian/Ubuntu)
sudo apt install libzmq3-dev liblmdb-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev libsqlite3-dev

# Ollama running locally with a model pulled
ollama pull gemma4:e2b
```

## Build

```sh
# build the runtime first
make

# build the employee-mesh demo
cd examples/employee-mesh
make
```

## Run

```sh
make run
```

This starts two processes (no PII filtering). Or run `make run` to start the full mesh with PII tokenisation — 5 processes:

```
[proxy]   zmq-proxy    — XSUB:5557  XPUB:5556
[actor]   tokenise-1   — topic: user_message, sql_result
[actor]   detokenise-1 — topic: sql_query_masked, agent_response_masked
[actor]   sqlite-tool-1 — topic: sql_query
[actor]   llm-agent-1  — topic: user_message_masked, sql_result_masked
```

::: {.callout-note}
The full `make run` enables PII tokenisation by default. Everything the LLM sees is tokenised; everything it emits is detokenised. See @agents for the PII Token Bubble design.
:::

## Chat

```sh
make chat
```

Opens the ncurses TUI. Type a question and press Enter. The agent explores the database, runs queries, and streams the answer back. Session history is preserved across turns in LMDB — follow-up questions work naturally.

## Stop

```sh
make stop
```

Kills all mesh processes and wipes the LMDB state directories.

## What just ran

```{mermaid}
sequenceDiagram
  participant C  as client
  participant TK as tokenise
  participant AG as llm-agent
  participant DK as detokenise
  participant DB as sqlite-tool

  C  ->> TK : user_message {query}
  Note over TK: mask PII entities
  TK ->> AG : user_message_masked
  AG ->> DK : sql_query_masked
  Note over DK: restore real names
  DK ->> DB : sql_query
  DB ->> TK : sql_result
  Note over TK: mask employee data
  TK ->> AG : sql_result_masked
  AG ->> DK : agent_response_masked
  Note over DK: restore answer
  DK ->> C  : agent_response
  BUS ->> AG : user_message
  Note over AG: call LLM, get SQL tool call
  AG ->> BUS : sql_query {sql}
  BUS ->> ST : sql_query
  Note over ST: execute against employee.db
  ST ->> BUS : sql_result {rows}
  BUS ->> AG : sql_result
  Note over AG: load LMDB state, call LLM with rows
  AG ->> BUS : agent_response {answer}
  BUS ->> C  : agent_response
```

The `llm-agent` subscribes to **two** topics — `user_message` and `sql_result` — and uses `ACTOR_CORRELATION_ID` to stitch both invocations into a single conversation turn stored in LMDB.
